claims.text: High-entropy alloying of ZrB2 with multiple elements can enable lower-temperature manufacture.
High-entropy alloying of ZrB2 can improve strength and structural integrity.
High-entropy alloying of ZrB2 can improve resistance to high-temperature oxidation.
High-entropy alloying of ZrB2 can improve resistance to liquid plating-metal corrosion.
Introducing multiple elements into ZrB2 creates a high-entropy alloy structure.
The resulting high-entropy alloy structure produces improved strength, structural integrity, oxidation resistance, and corrosion resistance.
The modified material will outperform single-phase ZrB2 in strength and structural integrity.
The modified material will outperform single-phase ZrB2 and prior lower-temperature specimens in resistance to high-temperature oxidation and liquid plating-metal corrosion.
The intervention is applicable at preparation temperatures below 1700 °C.
The proposed material is applicable at service temperatures below 1000 °C while exposed to a liquid plating metal.
